meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: Claude 会只读扫描仓库里所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR,每条各起一个后台任务分析,把带 permalink 证据的报告写入 /tmp/{时间戳}/;它不在 GitHub 上做任何写操作,只出报告。
howto.when: 当你说「triage」「triage issues」「triage PRs」等触发词,要求对仓库的 issue 或 PR 做归类分析时接管。

say.text: triage 一下这个仓库的所有 issue 和 PR
say.note: 只读分析,报告写入 /tmp 时间戳目录
每个 PR 一份审查报告,不改动 GitHub

say.text: triage issues,找出哪些 bug 已经修好了
say.note: 每条 issue 一份带 permalink 的报告

howto.what_en: Read-only scans all open issues and PRs, spawns one background task per item, writes reports with permalink evidence to /tmp/{datetime}/. Never acts on GitHub - no comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", or "github triage" - i.e. when you want open issues or PRs classified and analyzed.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues and PRs in this repo
Triage PRs and tell me which are ready to merge
say_en.note: One review report per PR, no GitHub changes

say_en.text: Triage issues and find which bugs are already fixed
say_en.note: Each issue gets a permalink-backed report
